statement: {α : Type u_1} → (s : Finset α) → ↥s ≃ ↑↑s
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (n : ℕ) (a : α), (Multiset.replicate n a).toFinset = if n = 0 then ∅ else {a}

∀ {α : Type u_3}, Set.univ = {∅} ↔ IsEmpty α
